title: The Overseer's First Test
briefing:
So you are $N. I have been told to expect a $C with more curiosity than sense.

Something new is watching this valley, and it wants to know what you are made of. The kobolds east of the abbey will do for a first measure. Thin them out and come back to me.
objectives_text: Slay 4 Kobold Vermin in Northshire Valley, then return to Marshal McBride.
progress_text: The Overseer is patient, $N. The kobolds are not going anywhere. Well, four of them are.
completion_text: Four fewer vermin, and you are still standing. The Overseer has taken note.
